notes.title: 值班手记-网关
notes.body: 昨晚网关偶发超时，值班同学刷新了几次页面，后来自己好了。没有留下标准步骤。

notes.title: 值班手记-支付
notes.body: 有用户说扣了两次款，财务对了一下账，好像是网络抖动。未形成规范。

notes.title: 值班手记-索引
notes.body: 有人抱怨搜索不到刚写的笔记，重启了电脑。未记录根因。

experiences.title: gateway timeout retry policy
experiences.trigger: when gateway timeout happens in production
experiences.procedure: retry 3 times with fixed backoff of 200ms

experiences.title: duplicate charge guard
experiences.procedure: attach an idempotent key per request id before charging

experiences.title: broken index recovery
experiences.trigger: when search misses freshly written notes
experiences.procedure: run rebuild-index after verifying markdown files still exist
experiences.boundary: never git checkout to undo a successful md write
